With sum_i t_i=0 and s=(3-lambda)/(1+lambda), exact necessary-and-sufficient vertex illumination conditions are t_i+s*t_l<0. At most one negative-orbit vertex can be illuminated (also weighted lower I*>=4); for all s in (0,1), four constructed rays t=(2-s+delta,s-delta,-1,-1), delta=0.5 min{s,(1-s)^2/s}, cover all 8 vertices, giving I=I*=4 outside cube; cube needs 8. Three-positive criterion (3s-1)T<0 proves sharp alpha transitions at lambda=1/2,2, with remaining boundaries treated exactly. Independently reconstructed 12 facets and all four rays for seven rational lambda; continuum claim rests on symbolic proof.
